title: Dr. Dominique Lamonica
text:
Not at my usual desk, in BCI, Panama



Stuff I’m interested in:

Analysing ecology data.
Bayesian (& frequentist) statistics.
Ecotoxicology.
Handling multiple data type.
High performance computing.
Model development & statistical inference.
Movement ecology.
(R) programming.
Reproductibility.
Spatial statistics.
Teaching.
(Tropical) forests.
Upscaling biological levels from individual to landscape.




Some info

Research engineer at IRD Institute of Research for Development since 2023, based in Montpellier, France.
AMAP lab botAny and Modeling of Plant Architecture and vegetation, POLIS Computing for science
Member of ISI IRD Network for informatics in research, LiStat International Research Network for Life Statistics
Github, Forge IRD, email: dominique.lamonica[at]ird.fr



Some of my current activities

BIOMASS R package lead dev CRAN & Github
gecevar R package development Github
R training ISI more info
Teaching ‘Introduction to modelling’ at Montpellier SupAgro
ads R package maintainer CRAN

title: Dr. Dominique Lamonica
text:
Teaching & Training

ISI trainings: R for beginners, GIT
University courses: Statistics (L1/L3/M2), Dynamical systems (L3/M1), Modelling and statistics using R (L2), Introduction to modelling (L2/L3) at University Claude Bernard Lyon 1, INSA Lyon, Montpellier SupAgro
Summer/Winter School: Ecotoxicology and Predictive Modelling at SETAC PREDITOX



Postdocs & Research contracts

Research Engineer: TKTD modelling of birds exposed to pesticides - MEPS, LBBE, University Claude Bernard Lyon 1 - 04/2022 to 02/2023 - Lyon, France
Postdoctoral fellow: Trajectometry and fish behaviour in the Rhône river - Riverly-Ecoflows, Inrae - 05/2016 to 10/2017 and 07/2020 to 12/2021 - Lyon, France
Postdoctoral fellow: Data-driven modelling of forest dynamics - Institute of Landscape and Plant Ecology, Hohenheim University - 11/2017 to 06/2020 - Hohenheim, Germany
PhD candidate: Bayesian dynamic modelling of a three-species laboratory microcosm under chemical pressure - MEPS, LBBE and IPE, LEHNA, University Claude Bernard Lyon 1 - 01/2013 to 04/2016 - Lyon, France



Education

Ph.D. in ecological modelling - University Claude Bernard Lyon 1 - 04/2016 - Lyon, France
Engineering degree in environmental engineering - Ecole Nationale Supérieure Agronomique de Toulouse (INP-ENSAT) - 09/2012 - Toulouse, France
